Class ReplicaTrainer

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.Trainer
dev.swordai.client.ReplicaTrainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentSession
Direct Known Subclasses:
HeadlessSession, SparLearnSession
abstract class ReplicaTrainer extends Trainer
Training in which the agent's body is a fake player, run as if it had a game client of its own (ReplicaBody), with a picture that is drawn for it rather than read off the screen. This class is that body, as Trainer asks for it. Who it fights, and what starts and ends a fight, is the subclass's.

Everything about the training runs on the server thread. The client thread only asks: for the status, and for a stop, which it hands over. Nobody's keys are taken.
